meta.name: dispatching-parallel-agents
meta.description: Use when facing 2+ independent tasks that can be worked on without shared state or sequential dependencies

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 并行执行多个独立任务，无需等待顺序完成
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要同时处理多个互不依赖的任务
copy.tagline_en: Execute multiple independent tasks in parallel without waiting
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to handle multiple independent tasks simultaneously

howto.what: 当你有多个互不依赖的任务时，Claude 会同时派出多个子代理分别处理，每个子代理只专注于自己的任务，最后汇总结果。
howto.when: 当你遇到 3 个以上测试文件失败且原因不同，或多个子系统独立故障时触发。

say.text: 帮我同时修复这三个测试文件的失败用例。
say.note: Claude 会并行派出子代理分别处理每个文件。

say.text: 并行调查子系统A、B、C的独立故障。
say.note: 每个子系统由单独的子代理负责。

howto.what_en: When you have multiple independent tasks, Claude dispatches several sub-agents in parallel, each focusing on its own task, then integrates results.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you have 3+ test file failures with different root causes, or multiple independently broken subsystems.

say_en.text: Fix the failing tests in these three files simultaneously.
say_en.note: Claude dispatches parallel sub-agents for each file.

say_en.text: Investigate independent failures in subsystems A, B, and C in parallel.
say_en.note: Each subsystem gets its own sub-agent.
